findings.title: New exit-code parameter breaks process error listeners
findings.description: `src/index.ts` registers `handleError` directly for `uncaughtException` and `unhandledRejection`. Those events supply an origin string or Promise as the second argument, now interpreted as an exit code. Verified locally: the origin string causes `process.exit()` to throw `ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE`. Wrap both listeners so they pass only the error.

findings.title: Fixing an inferred docType can falsely report success
findings.description: `validateFrontmatter()` returns immediately when `docType` is missing. After fixing that field, this command removes the finding without revalidating. A slice document missing `docType` and other required fields therefore exits successfully despite remaining invalid. Revalidate modified documents before determining the exit status, and add a regression test using the real validator.

findings.title: Worktree invocation validates or modifies the main checkout
findings.description: The resolver detects worktree context, but the command discards it and always uses `project.projectPath`. From a registered worktree, a no-path run checks—and with `--fix`, edits—the main checkout. Explicit worktree paths are instead silently excluded by the service’s main-root containment check. Resolve the active checkout root and test both invocation modes.

findings.title: Date backfill can overwrite the actual fix timestamp
findings.description:
For a document missing both `status` and `dateUpdated`, the validator emits fixes in that order. Fixing `status` stamps today, but the subsequent `dateUpdated` fix writes the original `dateCreated` value. The writer intentionally ignores its timestamp argument when updating `dateUpdated` itself. Ensure the final timestamp reflects this run’s actual edit.

Tests could not run: dependencies are absent (`vitest: command not found`).
